svg.title: After a CSE dose: prolonged deceleration with uterine hypertonus and normal BP
svg.desc: Ten-minute synthetic strip at US paper scale. Same FHR fall to about 80 bpm from 2.5 to 5.5 minutes after a combined spinal-epidural dose at 2 minutes, but maternal BP stays near 120/75. IUPC shows a resting tone of 15 mmHg and a sustained contraction from 2.25 to 4.75 minutes at about 60 mmHg without relaxation. Action marker: oxytocin off, palpate, uterine relaxant.
